title: Yousei Daiensou ~ Touhou Sangetsusei - Staking Your Life on a Prank
description:
The stage 1 and 2 boss theme from Great Fairy Wars. It's a menacing but ultimately lighthearted song, and a song I like a lot.

Transcribing this made me realize how bizarre the bassline is in parts.
